checkpoint_review: The Router's verdicts are largely accurate but slightly lenient on the 'Geometry' checkpoint. While the object has the *shape* of a menu, the 'structured typography' is functionally absent due to gibberish. I agree with marking functional checkpoints as false. The Router correctly identified that while the layout mimics a menu, the content fails the definition of a 'listing'.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified 'text_gibberish' as a severity 5 artifact. This is the defining failure of the image. The 'texture_anomaly' (severity 3) is also valid, as AI-generated text often lacks the crisp ink-on-paper edge definition. The green bounding boxes are correctly noted as external overlays and ignored for generation quality. The Perceptual Quality Auditor's claim that 'text is legible' is factually incorrect based on the Image Text Auditor's output (nonsensical strings like 'aahne', 'fao-rtr'), demonstrating the limitation of general VLMs in detecting semantic text failure.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails the core definition of the class 'menu' which requires a 'listing of available food and beverage items'. Since the text is nonsensical gibberish (confirmed by Image Text Auditor), it is not a listing. The Fine Grained Classifier further supports this misalignment by ranking 'web site' and 'screen' higher than 'menu', indicating the visual features (dense, illegible text blocks) resemble digital noise or low-res web captures more than a physical document. Only the geometric silhouette and color scheme align with the class prototype.
artifact_reasoning: Catastrophic text generation failure. The text is not just blurry; it is structurally malformed (gibberish), which is a severity 5 artifact for any document-based class. The edges of the characters show melting/fusion into the background (severity 3). The image effectively fails to render the primary texture component (legible text) of the subject.
key_defects: Text Gibberish: All textual content is nonsensical and illegible.
Class Misalignment: The object functions as a visual prop resembling a menu, but fails the functional requirement of being a readable list.
Character Fusion: Letterforms melt into each other and the background.
